description: Add tags to, or remove tags from, one running deployment, e.g. to mark the match it serves or that a test is done, so edgegap_list_deployments can filter on them. Tags are labels only: the game server does not see the change. The "edgegap-mcp" tag cannot be removed, since it is how agent deployments are found and cleaned up. Returns the tags now on the deployment.

add.description: Tags to add, at most 40 characters each.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

request_id.description: The exact request_id of the deployment.

name: edgegap_tag_deployment
title: Add or remove tags on a running deployment
